propositions: Extract cohesive identity-transition rules from BindingStore into BindingLifecycle while preserving exact existing behavior for bind, confirm, unbind, reverse cleanup, and numeric-ID re-key.
Every valid transition must leave at most one forward entry and one matching reverse entry, verified by reloading both indexes from disk.
bind_confirm must remain last-writer-wins on the forward entry and pop exactly one differing old reverse key with no sweep or ambiguity detection.
Stale reverse entries may be removed only in four permitted cases: rebind with different jira_key, unbind with sweep of orphans, re-key old-to-new transition, and retire operations.
Numeric-ID matches must trigger re-key mutation (updating jira_key, resetting absent_404_count, swapping index entries) instead of retiring.
note_absent_or_rekey remains facade-owned as coordinator; only the re-key step (identity comparison and index mutation) moves to BindingLifecycle, with no outcome change to absence fallthrough.
